rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 285 OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 7160 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991' (Provides a revised formula in determining the revenue allocation to local government units)
rows.abstract: Provides the following formula in determining the  share  of local government units  in  the internal revenue allotment: (1) Population ---  [50%] 40%     (2) Land area ---  [25%] 40%     (3) Equal Sharing -  [25%] 20% Provides, further. that on theFIRST YEAR  of the effectivity of this Code, and up to the THIRD YEAR and thereafter, the "population and  equal sharing" scheme shall be adjusted accordingly.  * * *
